summary_1line: Vaisampayana recounts the ancient origin, transmission, and supremacy of Narayana devotion, explaining its cosmic lineage and connection to Sattva and liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: From the navel of Narayana resting on the cosmic waters, a lotus rises and Brahma appears seated upon it at the dawn of creation.
Narayana instructs the newly born Brahma, granting him the Sattwata religion and the power to create the worlds.
Ancient rishis gathered around Narada while Krishna and Bhishma listen as the sage expounds the secret doctrine of devotion.
